methods.text: Utah's Crash Costs for Calendar Year 2026 (UDOT Traffic and Safety Division memo to FHWA Utah Division) (Utah Department of Transportation, Traffic and Safety Division, March 16, 2026 (2025 dollars)), Table 1 'Utah's Crash Costs for Calendar Year 2026 (2025 Dollars)', p. 1; rule 'Application of Severity Distributions and Crash Cost Values' 2, pp. 3-4
not available for Utah: UDOT's crash-cost memo and HSIP manual (June 2025) give no statewide average crash rates by facility type, and CrashIQ has no Utah traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Utah's own method, UDOT ranks HSIP projects by benefit-to-cost ratio from crash history, statewide crash models of the state system and usRAP (UDOT HSIP Manual, June 2025, Sec. 5.1.2.1 and 5.1.3, pp. 14-15), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)
not available for Utah: UDOT's documents read here set no minimum study period for a corridor study
